# ToolDB

> ToolDB is a curated catalog of 72+ digital tools organized by category. Discover, compare, and explore alternatives to popular software by category, platform, pricing model, and use case.

ToolDB provides structured, unbiased information about each tool including features, pricing models, platform availability, and use cases. All content is independently researched — affiliate relationships do not influence recommendations.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://tooldb.org/): Browse all tools and categories.
- [All Tools](https://tooldb.org/tools): Complete catalog of 72+ tools.
- [Categories](https://tooldb.org/categories): Explore tools by category.
- [Alternatives](https://tooldb.org/alternatives): Find alternatives to popular software like Jira, Mailchimp, HubSpot, Notion, and more.

## Alternatives to Popular Software

- [Jira Alternatives](https://tooldb.org/alternatives/jira): ClickUp, monday.com, Wrike — simpler and cheaper project management.
- [Mailchimp Alternatives](https://tooldb.org/alternatives/mailchimp): Brevo, Kit, ActiveCampaign, GetResponse, Campaign Monitor, AWeber, Drip, Moosend — better value email marketing.
- [HubSpot Alternatives](https://tooldb.org/alternatives/hubspot): Pipedrive, Close, ActiveCampaign, Brevo, Freshdesk, Zendesk — focused CRM without enterprise pricing.
- [Notion Alternatives](https://tooldb.org/alternatives/notion): ClickUp, Miro, Todoist, Wrike — more structure or better performance.
- [Zoom Alternatives](https://tooldb.org/alternatives/zoom): Livestorm, Fireflies.ai, Restream — browser-based, AI notes, multistreaming.
- [Trello Alternatives](https://tooldb.org/alternatives/trello): ClickUp, monday.com, Wrike, Todoist — more views and automations.
- [WordPress Alternatives](https://tooldb.org/alternatives/wordpress): Webflow, Netlify — no plugins, zero maintenance, faster sites.
- [Google Analytics Alternatives](https://tooldb.org/alternatives/google-analytics): Amplitude, Crazy Egg, Databox, Similarweb — privacy-first and simpler analytics.
- [Shopify Alternatives](https://tooldb.org/alternatives/shopify): Sellfy, Printify, Webflow — lower fees, simpler setup.
- [Slack Alternatives](https://tooldb.org/alternatives/slack): Fireflies.ai, respond.io, Tidio — AI notes, omnichannel, live chat.
- [Canva Alternatives](https://tooldb.org/alternatives/canva): Gamma, Miro — AI presentations and visual collaboration.
- [Calendly Alternatives](https://tooldb.org/alternatives/calendly): Livestorm, Fireflies.ai — scheduling plus webinars or AI notes.
- [Salesforce Alternatives](https://tooldb.org/alternatives/salesforce): Pipedrive, Close, Apollo.io, Freshdesk — simpler CRM at lower cost.
- [Otter.ai Alternatives](https://tooldb.org/alternatives/otter-ai): Fireflies.ai — AI transcription with CRM sync.
- [Teachable Alternatives](https://tooldb.org/alternatives/teachable): Thinkific, LearnWorlds, Circle — better pricing and community features.
